newsitem.title: USA: Vitalcom says Schlotterbeck to resign.
newsitem.headline: Vitalcom says Schlotterbeck to resign.

text.p: VitalCom Inc said David Schlotterbeck will resign as president and chief executive officer and become vice chairman of the board of directors.
It also said Donald Judson, chairman of the board, will become chief executive officer, effective January 1, 1997.
VitalCom also said expense cutbacks, as well as employee reductions in selected areas will result in a pre-tax charge of about $1.0 million in the current quarter.
Savings from this restructuring will be about $1.0 million per quarter beginning in the first quarter of 1997, bringing our expenses more closely in line with revenues.
